headline: Star Health First-Half Underwriting Profit Rises Amid Digital Push
summary: India's Star Health posted an increase in first-half underwriting profit, supported by an ongoing digital operational push across its health insurance product distribution networks.
why: Star Health is India's largest standalone private health insurer, benefiting from growing insurance penetration in the South Asian retail market.

entities.name: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company

impacts.name: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company
impacts.why: Underwriting profit expansion driven by digital efficiency strengthens overall operating profitability.
